description: This file defines an implementation class for a builder that constructs answer responses for live feature retrieve commands within a signal processing framework. It provides methods to create instances, build response objects, and handle errors related to feature accessibility in a Java-based Eclipse project.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing a builder for creating responses for retrieve feature live commands, supporting fluent API and extending an abstract base class.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An inner class implementing ResponseFactory, responsible for creating success and error response objects associated with retrieve feature commands.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of RetrieveFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl with the specified command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Overrides the method to generate a CommandResponse using the provided createResponseFunction and the internal ResponseFactory.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a successful RetrieveFeatureResponse object for a given feature, including entity ID and headers.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response specifically indicating that the feature is not accessible, utilizing the feature not accessible exception details.
